title: Coffee Costs 122% More Than in 2020 #shorts
description:
A pound of ground coffee cost $4.17 in January 2020. In October 2026 it cost $9.25: up 122%. Ground beef is up 74%, eggs 59%, bread 38%. Average hourly pay is up 34%.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics average prices (APU0000717311 coffee, APU0000703112 ground beef, APU0000708111 eggs, APU0000702111 white bread) and average hourly earnings, private (CES0500000003), via FRED.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
